channel.title: Mac Productivity Suite Changelog
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.title: Version 2.4.6 (Build 11)
item.description:
• Fixed number keys (1..9) not moving selector in UI when switching Chrome profiles.
  • Fixed avatar resolution for local and non-GAIA Chrome profiles to properly display profile pictures.
  • Fixed GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline compatibility across Swift 5.10 and Swift 6 environments.

item.title: Version 2.4.6 (Build 11)
item.description:

  • Fixed GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline compatibility across Swift 5.10 and Swift 6 environments.

item.title: Version 2.4.5 (Build 10)
item.description:
• Fixed in-app auto-updater (Sparkle) silently failing to install updates due to ad-hoc code signature Designated Requirement mismatch.
  • Implemented stable Designated Requirements for all future updates to ensure smooth in-place upgrades.
  • Fixed Swift 6 strict concurrency checks and added explicit AppKit imports across engine classes to ensure clean CI builds.
  • Note: You must manually download and install this version (v2.4.5) one last time. All future updates will install automatically.

item.title: Version 2.4.4 (Build 9)
item.description:
• Fixed in-app auto-updater (Sparkle) silently failing to install updates due to ad-hoc code signature Designated Requirement mismatch.
  • Implemented stable Designated Requirements for all future updates to ensure smooth in-place upgrades.
  • Note: You must manually download and install this specific version (v2.4.4) one last time. All future updates will install automatically.

item.title: Version 2.4.3 (Build 8)
item.description:
• Dynamic UI version display reading live bundle version metadata and syncing config
  • Eliminated repetitive accessibility prompts and onboarding loop for existing configurations
  • Fixed Chrome profile avatars with use_gaia_picture awareness and square center-cropping
  • Enhanced Settings Preferences view with live accessibility status indicator and version footer

item.title: Version 2.4.2 (Build 7)
item.description:
• Pre-compiled AppleScript bytecode cache for sub-millisecond browser profile switching
  • Modularized candidate item builder (buildSwitcherItems) and simplified engine control flow
  • Clean Swift 6 Sendable concurrency conformance and modern macOS 14+ application activation

item.title: Version 2.4.1 (Build 6)
item.description:
• Fix Chrome profile expansion, authentic profile avatars, and HUD overlay rendering
  • Instant profile window switching using Chrome native Profiles menu automation
  • High-DPI circular profile avatars with lettered monogram fallback support
  • Eliminated redundant generic app cards when binding specific browser profiles

item.title: Version 2.4.0 (Build 5)
item.description:
• Visual HUD overlay feedback on application selection and candidate cycling
  • Standard preset keybindings: F (Finder/Freeform), T (Telegram/Terminal), P (Photos/Passwords/Preview), N (Notes), C (Chrome/Profiles), S (Settings)
  • Interactive Onboarding Setup Wizard with Chrome profile discovery & favorite selection
  • Smart Terminal detection prioritizing iTerm2 over native macOS Terminal

item.title: Version 2.3.0 (Build 4)
item.description:
• Streamlined, ultra-minimal single-page Settings UI
  • Eliminated obsolete Accessibility permission requirements and prompts
  • Clean app rename to "Mac Productivity Suite" across all distributions
  • Native Chrome profile switching with authentic user avatars
  • Apple OSLog Unified Telemetry & Console.app diagnostics
